BEFORE YOU ENQUIRE

A few practical details

Clear requirements make the initial commercial discussion more useful.

What should I include in my enquiry?

Your company name and contact details, the product and grade, quantity, delivery point and indicative timing. If a requirement is still provisional, say so in your message.

Are grades, prices or availability confirmed online?

No. Product descriptions outline our commercial scope. Specifications, availability, pricing and delivery terms must be confirmed in a separate written quotation or agreement.

Does the form send my enquiry automatically?

No. It prepares a message in your email app for you to review and send to info@nbkdiesel.ae. If the app does not open, use “Copy enquiry” and send the message yourself.

Can I send confidential documents through this form?

Please do not include identity documents or banking credentials. Contact the Dubai office to agree a suitable channel before sharing sensitive transaction material.
